<!-- Thanks so much for your PR, your contribution is appreciated! ❤️ -->

**Badge issue**: #37835 
**Material You umbrella issue**: #29345

Closes #37835 

- [x] I have followed (at least) the [PR section of the contributing guide](https://github.com/mui/material-ui/blob/HEAD/CONTRIBUTING.md#sending-a-pull-request).

## Changes
- Copy Badge from `material`
- Migrate to Typescript
- Remove deprecated `components` and `componentsProps`
- Drop ThemeProvider in favor of CssVarsProvider
- Implement Material You design specs
- Add component playground to v5 docs
- Refactor styles to use component CSS Variables

## Breaking changes

https://github.com/mui/material-ui/pull/37850/files#diff-9548901bac6f3274c402a36fad9b83afe49cf663499e51d9fe306195d149a4a1

## CSS Variables

I was heavily inspired by Joy Badge's variables, but didn't use exactly the same. As naming convention, I followed [Material You's token convention](https://m3.material.io/foundations/design-tokens/how-to-read-tokens#9edb5a47-17f1-4067-96a3-403aee901e2c) in which component variables have the `--md-comp` prefix followed by the component's name, so in this case it is: `--md-comp-badge`
